instructions.description: Place both hands on a wall at chest height.
Walk the feet back until the body forms a comfortable incline.
Bend the elbows and bring the chest toward the wall as one unit.
Press the wall away and return without locking the elbows forcefully.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Incline Push-Up meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Wall Push-Up.
Wall Push-Up — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Wall Push-Up — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
